title: All my notes disappeared
body: I’m really disappointed to the fact that I opened the notes app just to find all my notes that l jotted down over the years completely gone without a trace. It’s not even showing recently deleted nothing🚮what the heck???
author: Maya T Uandara

title: Deleting notes
body:
I’ve been using this app for my notes, it was all great until it deleted a whole set of my notes. I checked in my recently deleted there’s nothing, it’s as though they were never made at all. 
This was on the MacBook Air by the way.
Is there a way I can recover them (and no they are not on iCloud)
author: Bradley Murorua

title: The app keeps crushing
body: The app keeps closing as soon as I open it so I am unable to access my notes. Can you guys please sort this thing out.
author: Peter065
